title: streambeats nav row look
brief: Alternatives for the settings-screen nav hint row (↑↓ k/j · enter open · esc back · l lib · c settings · q quit): nicer separation between controls while honoring the painted-width tier ladder (issue #143 S9-S10, measured rune budgets 55/50/47/26/6). Each artboard shows the row at full tier and inside the owner's ~52-column side panel, with the tier cost.

artboards.title: Dot rhythm
artboards.tradeoff: Calm visible rhythm on wide panels; +5 runes at the full tier (60), so a 52-55 col side panel drops to the compressed tier more often — exactly where the owner reads the row

artboards.title: Key badges
artboards.tradeoff: Zero painted-width change (SGR-only keys on a dim band): the tier ladder stays untouched everywhere; loses the explicit separator, states by color instead

artboards.title: Zoned groups
artboards.tradeoff: Most scannable zones (navigate / settings / quit) with a divider bar; widest full tier (62, +7) — the tier ladder needs the biggest recalibration

artboards.title: Hybrid dots + badges
artboards.tradeoff: Owner hybrid: dot separators + SGR-badged keys; full tier grows to 60 (ladder recalibrates to 60/55/50/47/26/6) but the badge survives every tier at zero painted width

artboards.title: Single dot + badges
artboards.tradeoff: Owner's finalized refinement: one dot between the move pair and the rest, badges everywhere; smallest possible ladder recalibration (55→56 full tier) with zero badge degradation
